operation: saved aggregate selection and unit/display conversion only

protocol.weights: m_c=min(n_0c,n_1c); each row in class y cell c has weight m_c/n_yc; excluded cells zero

bootstrap.resampling_unit: all 1588 validation components jointly, then filter each contrast
bootstrap.weights_per_draw: recompute overlap weights with component multiplicities, keeping eligible cells fixed
bootstrap.empty_class_in_any_retained_cell: invalidate standardized draw for that contrast
bootstrap.interpretation: conditional on saved models and OOF predictions; excludes retraining, calibration and label uncertainty

sensitivity.outputs: all support, balance and point estimates

cost_values.serial_estimate_note: sum of separately measured frozen branches; conservative single-GPU sequential deployment
cost_values.measurement_identity: three timing replays, not three independent training runs

holdout_source_identity: prefix-defined partial malicious-source shift stress test
display_refinement: Original, retained-unweighted and weighted AUROC/FPR together within planned T3; no new analysis.
